# Normaltown USA robots.txt
# Goal: WELCOME AI answer engines so they can read and CITE Normaltown USA (GEO),
# while keeping normal search crawlers.
#
# NOTE: Cloudflare's "managed robots.txt" (Security > Settings > Bot traffic, and
# "Display Content Signals Policy" on the zone Overview) PREPENDS its own block that
# DISALLOWS GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Amazonbot and more. Turn that
# setting off in the Cloudflare dashboard or this file's Allow rules are moot.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes

# --- AI answer / citation crawlers (the GEO ones you WANT reading you) ---
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /
